I replied to Marcus in a thread on his message in #north-random. I said I've noted that the signed order form for Thornbury Cloth Co. is due 19 November, and that nothing else needed doing.

I also suggested he correct his post in #north-team, since anyone there may be working from the wrong date. I didn't open that channel to look at his post. I went by his own word that it has the wrong date.
